# The Blooming Tini

> Premium mobile bartending serving Philadelphia, Bensalem, Bucks County, and South Jersey. Founded by two moms who design custom-labeled cocktails, matcha bars, and the Bloom Bar — a hand-built mobile bar — for weddings, showers, corporate events, birthdays, wellness socials, and private parties. Licensed, insured, RAMP certified.

## Quick facts

- Service area: Philadelphia, PA · Bensalem, PA · Bucks County · Montgomery County · Delaware County · South Jersey
- Founders: two moms building the business side by side
- Brand promise: "Where Celebrations Bloom" — custom menus, custom cup labels, the Bloom Bar setup, fresh seasonal ingredients
- Specialties: weddings, bridal showers, baby showers, corporate events, milestone birthdays, engagement parties, wellness/Pilates socials, backyard parties
- Pricing: packages from $350 (Essential, 3 hrs) · $550 (Premium, 4 hrs, most popular) · $850 (Luxe, 5 hrs)
- Operating model: dry hire — client provides alcohol, we provide everything else (bartenders, glassware, mixers, garnishes, setup, insurance)
- Certifications: RAMP certified · liquor liability insured · general liability insured

## Signature menus

### Blooming Brunch
- Aperol Spritz — aperol · prosecco · soda · orange slice
- Bloody Mary — vodka · house mix · pickled garnish
- Tropical Mimosa — Malibu rum · champagne · pineapple juice · grenadine
- Peach Bellini — prosecco · peach puree · fresh peach

### Signature Blooms
- The Garden Bloom — gin · elderflower · muddled cucumber · edible blossom (signature)
- Rose Petal Martini — vodka · rose · lychee · prosecco float
- Sage Smoke Old Fashioned — bourbon · maple · orange bitters · burnt sage smoke
- Espresso Petal — espresso martini with rose & cocoa
- The Tini Martini — classic gin · vermouth · house olive brine

### The Matcha Bar (wellness/Pilates events)
- Strawberry Soft Life Matcha — ceremonial matcha · strawberry · oat milk · custom labels
- Lavender Vanilla Matcha — lavender syrup · vanilla bean · ceremonial matcha
- Rose Honey Matcha — rose · raw honey · ceremonial matcha
